title: ControlKindRegistration
description: A control kind a design system adds (ADR-0226 §2.6). `ControlKind` is closed: a design system adds a kind only by registering it, under an `x-` name. The registration ships in the design system's control table (`$kinds`), where the generator reads it, and the design system registers it at run time with `registerControlKind`, so the browser and the generator derive the same schema.

verb.description: What using it does, as a tool description starts: "Set the price range of".

ControlKind.description:
The built-in control kinds, closed:

- `button`: press it (buttons, toolbar buttons, menu items, a row's action).
- `toggle`: set it on or off (switches, checkboxes).
- `text`: type into it (inputs, text areas).
- `number`: set a number (sliders, scrub fields).
- `choice`: choose one of its options (selects, radio groups, preset tiles).
- `multi-choice`: choose any of its options (multi-selects, checkbox groups, filter chips).
- `color`: set a colour or paint (colour pickers, swatches).
- `font`: choose a family and style (font pickers).
- `tabs`: select a tab.
- `date`: set a date.
- `date-range`: set a start and an end date.
- `dialog`: close it. Opening is its trigger's.

RegisteredControlKind.description: A kind a design system registers: `x-` and lower-kebab, so it never collides with a built-in one.

AnyControlKind.description: A built-in kind, or one a design system registers.

SchemaPropName.description: A key of `SchemaProps`: a prop a control's value schema is derived from.

ControlOption.description: One option of a choice, tab set or menu, as the control shows it.

SchemaProps.description: The props a control's input schema is derived from, by the one derivation (`deriveInputSchema`) the browser runs on live props and the generator on the props it reads statically. A live schema may narrow the generated one but never widen it.

wrap.description: Wraps past either end: an angle, where 181° is −179°.

paintKinds.description: The paint kinds a colour control offers: `solid`, `linear`, `radial`.

allowNone.description: A colour control can be set to no paint.

clearable.description: A choice that can be cleared (a toggleable tile grid).

KindSchemaDerivation.description:
How a registered kind's value schema follows from a control's props, as data, so the browser and the generator derive it with the same function: the schema, and which of its keywords each prop sets, by JSON Pointer. `options` sets a keyword to the values of the options that are not disabled.

```json
{ "schema": { "type": "object", "properties": { "low": { "type": "number" }, "high": { "type": "number" } } },
  "props": { "/properties/low/minimum": "min", "/properties/high/maximum": "max" } }
```
